name.local: 株式会社ディープコア

aum.raw: JPY 18.3 billion (total funds under management, secondary)

funds.name: DEEPCORE TOKYO I Investment Limited Partnership
DEEPCORE TOKYO II Investment Limited Partnership

strategy.thesis: AI-focused incubator and seed/early-stage investor, especially in deep learning, leveraging SoftBank Group's network and a co-working/R&D facility (KERNEL) in Hongo near the University of Tokyo and the Matsuo Lab.

program.eligibility: AI / deep learning entrepreneurs and early-stage startups

application.how_to_apply: Apply via DEEPCORE website / KERNEL membership

summary.en: DEEPCORE is a Tokyo-based AI-focused incubator wholly owned by SoftBank Group, launched in 2018. It runs the KERNEL incubation facility in Hongo (near the University of Tokyo's Matsuo Lab), provides GPU compute and seed/early-stage capital to deep-learning startups, and manages the DEEPCORE TOKYO funds.
summary.local: ソフトバンクグループ完全子会社のAI特化型インキュベーター。2018年設立、本郷にKERNELを運営。

strategy.thesis: Japan's first AI-specialized incubation program, run by recruitment-services company dip Corporation. Provides ~3 months of acceleration and seed investment to AI-related startups and talent, aiming to create AI mega-ventures.

program.eligibility: AI-related businesses and talented individuals from the startup-preparation stage

application.how_to_apply: Apply per cohort via dip's AI.Accelerator page

summary.en: AI.Accelerator, launched April 2017 by dip Corporation, is described as Japan's first AI-specialized incubation/support program. It runs a roughly 3-month accelerator with seed investment for AI startups and talent; cumulatively 105 companies were selected from ~750 applications across 16 cohorts as of 2021.
summary.local: ディップが2017年4月に開始した日本初のAI特化インキュベーションプログラム。約3ヶ月のアクセラレータとシード投資を提供。

name.local: Beyond Next Ventures株式会社 / BRAVE

aum.raw: JPY 22 billion (as of March 2021, across funds)

size.raw: first close ¥10 billion (~$67.7M); targeting up to ¥25 billion (~$168M)

strategy.thesis: Deep-tech focused VC and accelerator that translates university and lab research into companies across drug discovery, biotech/pharma, medical/digital health, AI, robotics/materials and agri-food.

investment.raw: Demo Day prize up to ¥2,000,000; eligibility for JST START grants up to ¥30M/year; BNV direct investment

program.eligibility: Individuals or teams interested in commercializing deep-tech research seeds with entrepreneurial vision; incorporation not required; non-Japanese welcome

application.how_to_apply: Apply per cohort via the BRAVE program site

summary.en: Beyond Next Ventures is a Tokyo deep-tech VC that runs BRAVE, described as Japan's largest deep-tech accelerator. Launched in 2016, BRAVE turns research seeds into R&D startups across drug discovery, biotech, medical, AI, robotics/materials and agri-food; it has supported 200+ researchers and enabled 300M+ USD in financing.
summary.local: ディープテック特化のVCが運営する国内最大級の研究者向けアクセラレーター『BRAVE』。創薬・バイオ・医療・AI・ロボティクス等を対象。

strategy.thesis: Tokyo Metropolitan Government acceleration program (operated by Beyond Next Ventures) dedicated to drug-discovery and medical/pharmaceutical startups, leveraging Tokyo's concentration of pharma companies, support organizations and investors.

summary.en: Blockbuster TOKYO is a drug-discovery and medical/pharmaceutical startup acceleration program sponsored by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government and operated by Beyond Next Ventures since FY2018. name.local: onlab web3（オープンネットワークラボ）

check_size.raw: approx. JPY 10 million to 30 million per company

strategy.thesis: web3/blockchain-focused track of Open Network Lab (Japan's first seed accelerator, run by Digital Garage Group), supporting crypto, NFT, infrastructure and on-ramp startups looking to enter the Japanese market, backed by Digital Garage's blockchain/crypto-exchange expertise.

Selected startups take an equity investment from Onlab Fund II (typically ~JPY 10M–30M), with support backed by Digital Garage's crypto-exchange and blockchain expertise.

summary.en: Sakura Deeptech Shibuya is a deep-tech accelerator launched in 2025 at Shibuya Sakura Stage, operated by Scrum Studio (Scrum Ventures) with Tokyu Land Corporation. It runs a ~6-month program for around 10 global startups/year in Climate Tech and AI/Robotics, with wet/dry labs, subsidized housing and MIT/Oxford mentorship. Inaugural 2025 cohort: 10 startups.

name.local: JAアクセラレーター（AgVenture Lab）

strategy.thesis: Agriculture/food-focused accelerator run by AgVenture Lab (established by the JA Group). Supports AgTech, FoodTech, LifeTech and related startups, leveraging the JA Group's farmer networks, retail infrastructure and financial (banking/insurance) assets.

program.eligibility: Startups with innovative ideas/technologies for food, agriculture and life

application.how_to_apply: Annual application (Jan-Mar) via JA Accelerator site

summary.en: JA Accelerator is an agriculture/food-focused accelerator operated by AgVenture Lab (JA Group's innovation lab), launched in 2019. It runs ~6-month batches of around 9 startups (e.g., Batch 7 in 2025 selected 9 from 189 applications), leveraging JA Group's farmer, retail and financial networks; 70+ startups supported across 7 batches.

strategy.thesis: Japan's first fintech-focused hub/community in Otemachi, born from Mitsubishi Estate, Dentsu and ISID. Provides facilities, community and (via its own fund) seed/early-stage support to fintech startups; runs the FINOPITCH global pitch contest.

application.how_to_apply: Membership application / FINOPITCH contest via FINOLAB site

summary.en: FINOLAB (The Fintech Center of Tokyo) is Japan's first fintech-focused hub/community, established in 2016 in Otemachi by Mitsubishi Estate, Dentsu and ISID. It hosts 57 startups, 31 corporations and 800+ individual members, runs the FINOPITCH global pitch contest, and provides seed/early-stage support through its own fund.

name.local: Plug and Play Japan株式会社

strategy.thesis: Vertical-specific accelerator running industry programs (Fintech, Insurtech, Mobility, Health, Smart Cities, New Materials & Packaging, Energy, Food & Beverage) that connect corporate partners with Japanese and international startups; runs large batch cohorts twice a year.

investment.raw: selective equity investment (PnP Ventures); batch participation typically equity-free

program.eligibility: Startups across the program verticals (Fintech, Insurtech, Mobility, Health, Energy, Food & Beverage, New Materials, Smart Cities)

application.how_to_apply: Apply to a vertical batch via Plug and Play Japan site

summary.en: Plug and Play Japan, operating since 2017, runs vertical (sector-specific) accelerator batches—Fintech, Insurtech, Mobility, Health, Smart Cities, New Materials & Packaging, Energy and Food & Beverage—connecting corporate partners with Japanese and global startups. Batches are large (e.g., 73 startups in Winter/Spring 2024; 51 in Summer 2025) and run roughly twice a year.
summary.local: 2017年から日本で業界特化型（フィンテック、モビリティ、ヘルス等）アクセラレーターを運営。年2回の大規模バッチ。

sources.quote: Plug and Play Japan selected 73 startups for the Winter/Spring 2024 Batch ... verticals included Fintech, Insurtech, Mobility, Health, Smart Cities, New Materials & Packaging, Energy, and Food & Beverage

sources.quote: Summer 2025 Batchで国内外合計51社のスタートアップを採択 ... 2017年より日本市場においてアクセラレータープログラムの運営

It is primarily a corporate-innovation/matching accelerator; selective equity investment occurs but standard batch participation is largely equity-free. Per-startup investment terms not disclosed.
